[Type] Reading
[Source] Practice collection
# Technology and jobs
Technology changes jobs, but it also creates new roles.
1. What is the author's point?
A. Technology only destroys jobs.
B. The structure of employment changes.
[Answer] B
[Explanation] The passage describes changes in employment.
[Distractor] A Over-inference: The word only is not supported.

[Type] Cloze
[Source] Cloze practice
# Logical links
The weather was cold. {{1}}, we went outside. We {{2}} our plans.
1. A. However B. Therefore C. Besides D. Instead
2. A. adopt B. adapt C. adept D. adjust
[Answer] A B

[Type] Matching
[Source] Gap-fill practice
# A short story
An introduction. {{1}}
A conclusion. {{2}}
[Option Pool] A. First link | B. Another link | C. Last link | D. A detail | E. A contrast | F. An example | G. A question
[Answer] A C
[Explanation] Each sentence connects the surrounding ideas.

[Type] Reorder
[Source] Reorder practice
# A logical sequence
[Reorder]
Introduction.
Conclusion.
Supporting example.
[Answer] A C B
[Explanation] The example follows the introduction.

[Type] Paraphrasing
[Source] Paraphrase practice
# A relative clause
The environment, which has long been neglected, is receiving more attention.
[Reference Paraphrase] People are paying more attention to the environment after neglecting it for a long time.
[Step1] Find the main clause.
[Step2] Preserve the time relationship.
[Step3] Use clear wording.

[Type] Writing
[Source] Writing practice
# A picture essay
[Picture] Two people are studying at a desk.
[Prompt] Write an essay of 160-200 words.
[Reference Essay] The picture depicts two different approaches to learning.
